tasks.title: Announcement #62
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement at a campus event.
tasks.transcript: Good afternoon everyone. We are excited to announce that the university's annual technology expo will be held next Thursday from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. in the convention center. Come and see the latest innovations from our engineering and computer science students.

questions.stem: What is the main topic of the announcement?
questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：这则公告的主要话题是什么？ 定位原文：We are excited to announce that the university's annual technology expo will be held next Thursday from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. in the convention center. 选项分析： A. An upcoming technology expo 一场即将到来的科技博览会。公告明确宣布年度科技博览会的时间地点，所以A选项正确。 B. A student meeting 一次学生会议。公告中未提及学生会议，所以B选项错误。 C. A computer science lecture 一场计算机科学讲座。公告中提到的是博览会（expo），而非讲座，所以C选项错误。 D. A new technology course 一门新的技术课程。公告中未提及课程，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the speaker hope the listeners will do?
questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：说话者希望听众做什么？ 定位原文：Come and see the latest innovations from our engineering and computer science students. （结合语境，这是邀请听众到场参观） 选项分析： A. Submit their projects 提交他们的项目。公告中未提及提交项目，所以A选项错误。 B. Prepare for a lecture 为一场讲座做准备。公告中未提及讲座，所以B选项错误。 C. Attend the expo 参加博览会。说话者说“来看看……”，意在邀请听众到场参加科技博览会，所以C选项正确。 D. Join the engineering club 加入工程俱乐部。公告中未提及加入俱乐部，所以D选项错误。
